title: Rethinking why "Cognitive dysfunction" predicts some, but not all, transdiagnostic symptom dimensions in older adults: Commentary on Hoy et al. (2026).
abstract: Hoy et al. (2026) wrote a brilliant article on the potential association between cognitive dysfunction and psychopathology in aging, characterized by the generalconstruct and spectra such as internalizing, thought disorders, and externalizing. This commentary proposes that cognitive dysfunction may lack specificity when investigating cognition in aging. I suggest that future research should further decompose cognitive dysfunction into subdomains, one of which is cognitive control processes, as they depend on frontal-related networks, which are among the first to decline with age.
